P.name: Runic Blade
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Riven's''' {{tip|ability}} casts generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Charge'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 3 times. '''Riven's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--not on-hit--> are empowered to each consume a stack to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|30 + (45-30)/17*(x-1) for 20}} AD}}, reduced to{{ft|50%|{{as|{{pp|key=%|(30 + (45-30)/17*(x-1))*0.5 for 20|formula=50% of non-structure damage}} AD}}}}against {{tip|structures}}. Against {{tip|monsters}}, it also deals {{as|50 '''additional bonus''' physical damage|physical damage}}.
P.description2: The '''bonus''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.

Q.name: Broken Wings
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' can activate ''Broken Wings'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a {{fd|0.3125}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. If '''Riven''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.
Q.description2: '''Riven''' slashes with her sword for each of the three casts, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies struck within an area, {{tip|Basic attack reset|resetting}} her basic attack timer, and ordering her to basic attack the target of ''Broken Wings'' if there are any.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|45 to 165}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60 to 80}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|45*3 to 165*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*3 to 80*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Riven''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} 225 units in the direction she is currently facing, or up to 225 units towards the target enemy, striking enemies in the target area 100 units away. This cast cannot cross terrain.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's effects.
Q.description5: {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's effects in a larger area while also {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} enemies hit 75 units over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. This cast can cross terrain.

W.name: Ki Burst
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' emits a flash of runic energy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.

E.name: Valor
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain, while granting herself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description2: '''''Riven''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash. Valor will cast at max range if cast beyond that.''

R.name: Blade of the Exile
R.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' empowers her blade for 15 seconds, gaining {{as|20% AD}} {{sti|ad|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' attack range}}, and increased range on ''{{ai|Broken Wings|Riven}}'' and ''{{ai|Ki Burst|Riven}}''.

After {{fd|0.5}} seconds, she can cast ''{{ai|Wind Slash|Riven}}'' within the duration.

R.name: Wind Slash
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' unleashes a wave of energy in a cone in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{as|{{pp|type= target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 200 for 9|key1=%|0 to 75|formula=2.667% per 1% missing health. ''This is capped at 200% bonus damage at 75% missing health.''}}|health}}.
R.leveling: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 55% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|100*3 to 200*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
